period: Latest completed UTC date shared by all seven source series
periodVerification: Explicit provider UTC calendar dates; all seven series present; current and future dates excluded.
metricDefinition: Provider-reported chain transaction count, not unique users, dollars, bridge transfers, batch count or proof count. The app applies no additional transaction filter. Transaction complexity differs between networks.

chains.name: Ethereum
chains.notes: Ethereum mainnet transactions. L2 execution counts are shown separately; rollup submissions are already part of the mainnet count.

chains.notes: Transactions executed on Base, an Ethereum L2. Its connection to Ethereum represents data publication and settlement, not measured bridge transfers.

provenance.extraction: Exact integer value for metric_key txcount. Latest completed UTC date in the intersection of all seven series; no estimates, mixed dates or additional transaction filtering.
provenance.classification: Provider metadata identifies Ethereum as production L1 and the six others as production rollups using Ethereum data availability.
provenance.visualDefinition: Walking figures represent rounded transaction units on one shared linear scale. Ethereum town hall represents its settlement and data-availability role, not a central operator. Routes and batch vehicles are conceptual; no measured bridge volume, batch cadence, proof count, transfer value or capital flow is claimed.
comparisonNotes: Transactions are not people, users, dollars or a ranking of economic value.
One transaction can contain different amounts of work on different networks.
L1 transactions and L2 execution transactions remain separate; their sum is not unique end-to-end economic activity.
Six selected L2s do not represent the entire Ethereum L2 ecosystem.
Activity does not establish a price forecast or guarantee value accrual to ETH.
